author: vivekkarri

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Load bookworm image
2. Run config reload -y -f

#### Describe the results you received:

```
Oct 28 04:57:11.748425 arc-switch1025 NOTICE ntpd[11546]: ERR: ntpd exiting on signal 15 (Terminated)
Oct 28 04:58:42.744484 sonic ERR ntpd[46252]: statistics directory /var/log/ntpsec/ does not exist or is unwriteable, error No such file or directory
Oct 28 04:58:45.727232 sonic NOTICE ntpd[46252]: ERR: ntpd exiting on signal 15 (Terminated)
Oct 28 04:58:51.578765 sonic ERR ntpd[47271]: statistics directory /var/log/ntpsec/ does not exist or is unwriteable, error No such file or directory
```

comments.author: saiarcot895
comments.body: The statistics directory error message is known and added to the loganalyzer ignore list in sonic-net/sonic-mgmt#10502.

comments.author: dgsudharsan
comments.body:
@saiarcot895 Looks like the loganalyzer is catching the below log as error due to presence of ERR eventhough log level is NOTICE. Can you please add this to ignore list as well?
Oct 28 04:58:45.727232 sonic NOTICE ntpd[46252]: ERR: ntpd exiting on signal 15 (Terminated)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

When exiting, ntpd from NTPsec logs a message containing ERR at NOTICE level saying that it is exiting because of a signal. This causes loganalyzer to flag the message because ERR is present. This log message happens during graceful termination (such as when systemd is restarting the service). Therefore, ignore it.

This is applicable only to a Bookworm base image.

#### How did you do it?

Add the log message regex (but looking only for signal 15) to the loganalyzer ignore list. If other exits with other signals pop up on loganalyzer, they can be handled or added as needed.
